test_DatetimeIndex_delete: test the DatetimeIndex.delete method to remove a single element by integer index
test_DatetimeIndex_delete_negative: test the DatetimeIndex.delete method with negative indices to remove elements from the end
test_DatetimeIndex_delete_slice: test the DatetimeIndex.delete method with a slice to remove a contiguous range of elements
test_DatetimeIndex_delete_preserve_freq: test that DatetimeIndex.delete preserves the frequency when removing edge elements
test_DatetimeIndex_delete_reset_freq: test that DatetimeIndex.delete resets frequency to None when removing middle elements
